name: Space Exploration
description: Satellites, probes, space stations and telescopes, from Sputnik to the James Webb Space Telescope.

checkpoints.name: The first steps
checkpoints.note: Sputnik 1 opens the space age in 1957 and Yuri Gagarin becomes the first person in orbit in 1961. The first probes reach the Moon and fly past Mars.

checkpoints.name: The Moon and the first stations
checkpoints.note: Astronauts walk on the Moon in 1969. Probes land on Venus and Mars, the first space stations are launched, and the Voyagers set off for the outer planets in 1977.

checkpoints.name: Shuttles, Mir and Hubble
checkpoints.note: The Space Shuttle flies from 1981, the Soviet station Mir is assembled in orbit, and the Hubble Space Telescope is launched in 1990. The first small rover drives on Mars in 1997.

checkpoints.name: The space station years
checkpoints.note: Building of the International Space Station begins in 1998, and crews have lived on it without a break since 2000. China flies its first astronaut in 2003, and twin rovers explore Mars.

checkpoints.name: Rovers and reusable rockets
checkpoints.note: Car-sized rovers land on Mars, probes reach Pluto and the far side of the Moon, rockets begin to land and fly again, and the James Webb Space Telescope is launched in 2021.
